```yaml
name: TS Audit
on:
  push:
    branches:
      - main
  pull_request:
    branches:
      - main
jobs:
  audit:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Setup Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: '20'
          cache: 'pnpm'

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: pnpm install

      - name: Run audit
        run: |
          pnpm run audit
```
